title: Ash-Lanced
text: A furnace-raked wound that never fully seals.
flavor: The skin shines like coal glass under hard light.
trigger: Your first failed grit test each session.
penalty: Gain a route note about what hurt you after the failure resolves.

effect.text: Ash-Lanced scar recorded the source of the failed grit test.

relief: At a surgery or shrine space, spend 1 trophy after a passed forge check to suppress this scar until the next collapse.
upside: After this scar records the hit, gain a route note about what hurt you.
